declared: 2026-09-16, committed and pushed before any boundary computation
kind: single-cell open-loop numerics; no plant, no network, no V2.1 battery
principal_delta: direct resolution of two boundaries on the sealed E b-dispersion family; no new mechanism, parameter, or criterion for the family

cell.integrator: engine-order forward Euler as in intrinsic.py

frozen.population: b_i(w) = intrinsic.lognormal_dispersion(0.2, w, 300, 31001); a, c, d at P0 for every cell
frozen.background_for_rate_cv: V2.1c protocol unchanged: low_sm2p0 shot E columns (seed 21100), open-loop recurrent surrogate and native noise (seed 31000), I0 = V_LOW E tonic, 4 x 5 s chunks, windows 1-3

definitions.spontaneous_cell: intrinsic.deterministic_rate_cv(a, b, c, d, I=0.0, dur_s=10.0) rate > 0: at least one spike in the last 5 s of 10 s, noise-free, dt 0.1 ms, initial state v = c, u = b*c
definitions.S(w): exists i in the M=300 population with spontaneous_cell(b_i(w))
definitions.w_spontaneous: inf{w : S(w)} (reviewer definition: first intrinsically active cell; no fraction threshold)
definitions.CV(w): min over analysis windows 1-3 of intrinsic.window_metrics(raster)['rate_cv'] from test_v21c_intrinsic_design._run with only b dispersed at width w (the sealed width-scan quantity)

A_b_crit.endpoint_reproduction: spontaneous_cell(b=0.260) is False and spontaneous_cell(b=0.265) is True (sealed notes); otherwise UNRESOLVED
A_b_crit.method: bisection on b in [0.260, 0.265] until width <= 1e-6; b_crit reported as the (silent, firing) bracket
A_b_crit.V1_predicate_monotone_in_b: one vectorized run over b = 0.200, 0.2005, ..., 0.460 (521 cells): every b above b_crit_hi fires and every b below b_crit_lo is silent; otherwise UNRESOLVED

B_w_spontaneous.endpoint_reproduction: S(0.05) is False and S(0.10) is True; otherwise UNRESOLVED
B_w_spontaneous.method: bisection on w in [0.05, 0.10] with direct population evaluation of S(w) until width <= 1e-4
B_w_spontaneous.V2_max_b_monotone_in_w: max_i b_i(w) nondecreasing on w = 0.0500, 0.0501, ..., 0.1000 (dispersion only, no dynamics); otherwise UNRESOLVED
B_w_spontaneous.C1_consistency: max_i b_i(w_sp_lo) < b_crit_hi and max_i b_i(w_sp_hi) >= b_crit_lo; otherwise UNRESOLVED
B_w_spontaneous.report: index, quantile rank, and b of the first spontaneous cell at w_sp_hi; its I=0 rate

C_w_CV.R_reproduction: CV(0.20) and CV(0.30) recomputed equal the sealed min-window rate_cv in results/v21c_width_b.json within 1e-12; otherwise UNRESOLVED (code or environment drift)
C_w_CV.method: bisection on w in [0.20, 0.30] with predicate CV(w) >= 0.3 until width <= 0.005
C_w_CV.V3_below: CV(w_sp_hi) < 0.3 (one run) and the sealed CV at w = 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15 < 0.3; otherwise UNRESOLVED
C_w_CV.report: every evaluated (w, CV) pair; flag if CV is not nondecreasing over evaluated w

classification.SPONTANEOUS_BEFORE_CV: all gates pass and w_sp_hi < w_CV_lo
classification.CV_BEFORE_SPONTANEOUS: all gates pass and w_CV_hi < w_sp_lo
classification.COINCIDENT: all gates pass and the brackets overlap
classification.residual_assumption: no CV >= 0.3 excursion between evaluated widths below w_CV_lo (ASSUMED; bounded by V3 and the sealed grid)

verdict.SPONTANEOUS_BEFORE_CV: INTRINSIC_HETEROGENEITY_INFEASIBLE (tested single-parameter intrinsic family: the rate dispersion needed for V2.1 introduces zero-input E activity first)
verdict.CV_BEFORE_SPONTANEOUS: INTRINSIC_HETEROGENEITY_FEASIBLE (b reopened; no in-network execution while low_sm2p0 fails the prospective VIP band)

reported_not_gating: b_crit sensitivity: dur_s 40; initial v0 in {-70, -60} with u0 = b*v0; dt 0.05 ms
continuous-time rest point: saddle-node b = 5 - sqrt(22.4); Hopf b where trace = 0 (a = 0.02)
forward-Euler map (dt 0.1) rest-point stability boundary: spectral radius of the linearized map = 1
pacemaker count at w_sp_hi, w_CV_lo, w_CV_hi and at the sealed widths 0.2, 0.3
stop: write results/v21c_boundary.json, seal, STOP for review; do not open SCI-V21-GATE-REPAIR or any mechanism search
forbidden: changing the family, background, seeds, or tolerances after outputs
